scope: Official HUMETRO station-113 internal topology, BISCO underground-mall interface, exit-number namespaces, and platform vertical circulation. No Unity or scene work.

classification_legend.directly_supported: Exact official page, operator plan, or inventory supports the claim.
classification_legend.contradicts_premise: Official evidence conflicts with the modeled or stated premise.

classification_legend.insufficient: No primary integrated evidence resolves the claim.

key_verdicts.claim: The actual railway-to-Metro transfer is a purpose-built underground route through the 부산역지하도상가 interface, not an authored straight outdoor corridor from HUMETRO Exit 6.
key_verdicts.reason: HUMETRO identifies Exit 6 only as a 부산역광장 exit. BISCO's plan separately marks a 부산역 연결통로 branch from the underground mall, and Busan City describes the underground Metro-to-KTX connection.

key_verdicts.claim: The number 8 on the current BISCO plan is a 부산역지하도상가 surface-exit number, not a current HUMETRO station-113 exit number.
key_verdicts.reason: The live HUMETRO station exit table and station map enumerate 1–7; the independently operated BISCO mall plan enumerates 1–8.

key_verdicts.claim: An official Metro Exit 8 renumbering is established.
key_verdicts.reason: No official HUMETRO source found in this lane lists station 113 Exit 8. The observed 8 belongs to the mall plan.

implementation_constraints: Do not model the transfer as HUMETRO Exit 6 to plaza to an authored straight corridor.
Namespace HUMETRO exits and BISCO mall exits separately.
The supported sequence is platform -> upper Metro concourse -> unresolved exact HUMETRO/BISCO seam -> mall main spine -> labelled 부산역 연결통로 branch near mall exits 1–2 -> 2019 passage -> KTX end.
Do not convert source-image pixels into world metres; they only locate evidence in schematic images.
Keep the Metro/mall seam provisional until an integrated architectural plan or measured observation supplies a shared control point and dimensions.
